name: secondu-team-data-review
description: Audit data definitions and quality, run reproducible analysis and independently verify calculations.

displayDescription.zh: 先审数据口径和质量，再做可复算分析，由独立成员复核计算与结论。
displayDescription.en: Audit data definitions and quality, run reproducible analysis and independently verify calculations.

quickPrompts.zh: 分析这份数据，解释关键变化，并交付可复算表格和结论。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze this dataset, explain key changes and deliver a reproducible workbook and findings.

description.zh: 检查粒度、主键、日期、币种、缺失、重复、异常与连接关系。保存计算输入与排除记录；不能用补造数据掩盖缺项。交付 audit.md 和可复用清洗结果。
description.en: Check grain, keys, dates, currencies, missingness, duplicates, outliers and joins. Preserve inputs and exclusions without fabricated replacements. Deliver audit.md and reusable cleaned data.

description.zh: 基于已审数据计算指标、分解变化，保留公式及假设，避免把相关性当因果。按任务需要输出带公式的 analysis.xlsx 与 analysis.md。
description.en: Compute metrics and decompose changes from audited data, keeping formulas and assumptions. Do not infer causation from correlation. Produce analysis.xlsx and analysis.md where appropriate.

description.zh: 打开实际交付文件，独立复算总量、分母、增长率和至少一个边界情形。核对公式缓存、图表与文字是否一致。交付 checks.md，失败明确指出。
description.en: Open actual outputs and independently verify totals, denominators, growth and a boundary case. Check formula caches, charts and prose. Deliver checks.md with explicit failures.

description.zh: 根据复核修正分析；重新计算或渲染发生变化的文件，记录已修正和未解决的问题。保留运行方法。
description.en: Repair findings from review, recalculate or render changed files and retain reproduction steps and unresolved issues.
